name: Reset
overview:
A new comedy drama from Keshet 12, created, written and directed by comedian Adir Miller.

The series follows Gidi, a regular IDF soldier who experiences a double shock: After receiving terminal medical news that led him on a journey of rebellion and disintegration, he discovers that there was a mistake in the tests. Now, healthy but surrounded by the ruins he caused with his own hands, he must choose between trying to repair the fragments and embarking on a completely new path, far from the familiar path of his life.
